projects.description: An autonomous vehicle project based on a Raspberry Pi Pico, integrating Servo Motors, DC Motors, PWM Speed Control, Ultrasound Sensors, Multi-core Code on the official Arduino/Mbed Core
evidence: 1 GitHub stars and 1 forks. These can be manipulated and are not proof of quality.
GitHub topics: arduino, arduinocore-mbed, autonomous, car, cars, core0.

opportunity.reason: The repository declares early development and lists concrete unfinished work.

stage.text: The code is a work in progress, and for interest/reference. Mostly, it's working fully now, apart from the bits where it doesn't and crashes (the car, not the code). E&OE.

tasks.title: Implement LIDAR, for higher speeds, using adaptive 270° overlapping field of view scan zones (180° forward + 90° left side, 180° rearward + 90° right side)

Implement [wheel hub magnets based on this design](https://www.tinkercad.com/things/0p47F2eLgXn-rc-car-wheel-insert-for-neodymium-magnets) and integrate with [A3214EUA-T Hall Effect sensor](https://www.allegromicro.com/-
Add 'oh hell no' sensors for permanent last resort accident prevention

factors.label: Source quality
factors.detail: License listed; README present; source present; tests not found; CI not found. Complete file listing checked. File presence does not prove working software or security.

factors.label: Active development
factors.detail: Fresh GitHub metadata and code pushed within 30 days. Activity in the last two days receives full credit; older activity decays.

factors.label: Adoption
factors.detail: Capped, logarithmic stars and forks. This measures repository adoption, not current virality. Popularity alone cannot earn an 80+ score.

factors.label: Demo & theme
factors.detail: Characters that think and do. Theme matching is based on repository metadata, not measured virality. An actual project demo is available.

factors.label: GitHub momentum
factors.detail: No fresh Trending placement or measured growth. Total stars do not earn momentum points.

factors.label: Social traction
factors.detail: Fresh, directly linked X posts: measured reach, distinct authors, recency and engagement. Missing views earn no points and are shown as unknown. Audiences are never added together.
